name: Word Document Generator
description: Generate DOCX reports, letters, and contracts with full Unicode support (Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Hebrew) using python-docx. Output saved to the workspace.
short_description: Create multilingual Word documents with tables and images.
store_description: Creates .docx files using python-docx. Handles any language (Arabic RTL via paragraph alignment, CJK, Cyrillic). Supports styled headings, tables with formulas, embedded images, headers/footers, and page breaks. Always verifies the output file before reporting success.

examples.context: User provides the recipient, subject, and body text.
examples.expected_outcome: A .docx file with formatted header, body, and signature saved as letter.docx.

examples.context: User provides contract clauses in Arabic.
examples.expected_outcome: A right-aligned .docx contract with proper Arabic paragraph direction and a signature block.

examples.description: Create a project report with tables
examples.context: User provides a project summary and a task table.
examples.expected_outcome: A .docx report with heading, styled table, and a chart image saved as report.docx.
